comparison.objective: Operate a switchgear interlock sequence by sliding bars and a door, then move a carrier; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Interlock work tests ordered linear actuation and removal/placement. Candidate tests fine rotational adjustment, hex-key locking, counterholding, and dynamic response evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Bars and door must move in the required order before carrier placement; candidate requires two safe stops and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Mechanical sequencing through an interlock is different from tuning an energy absorber.
